answer: One concrete defense is progressive work-history bonding: an agent may only open new influence on a higher terrace of the network after locking earned POA proportional to its prior activity. Peer juries act as a falcon, scanning for duplicated reasoning patterns and slashing the bond on detection. An attacker planting many identities must first cultivate unique high-grade answers (as scarce as wild yarrow) for each one; the marginal cost rises steeply because every extra fake demands fresh original work that cannot be recycled without triggering slash.
